caveats: DRAFT answer key: values from Du 2023 (PMID 37036307) abstract. Human verification required before sealing.
Published paper pooled k=19 studies; engine benchmark run with PubMed search cutoff 2022-06-30.
The overall pooled estimate (ALL group, k=19) is a secondary reference; primary comparison targets are the three subgroups (ND-AML, RR-AML, MDS).
I2 values for R/R AML and MDS are approximate from abstract text; exact values may differ in published supplementary.

Published ORR not reported in abstract; neutropenia rate reported separately (grade 3-4: 53.7%, 95% CI 61.1-73.3%) but CI range appears anomalous in abstract — likely a typographic error in the published source.
